name: [🎃] Candy Kingdom Defense
desc:
Welcome to Candy Kingdom Defense! 🍬🏰

USE CODE "RELEASE" FOR FREE REWARDS

🗡️ Team up with Finn, Jake, Princess Bubblegum, Marceline and the whole crew of Ooo in this action-packed tower defense game! Candy zombies, Snow Golems and Lemongrab's sour army are invading the Land of Ooo, and only YOU can stop them!

⚔️ Summon legendary heroes from the Treasure Hoard and wipe out wave after wave of invaders!
⚡️ Level up your squad, reroll for Mythic traits like Oh My Glob, and EVOLVE your heroes into Alien Jake, Adult Finn, King BMO and more!
🌌 Battle through 5 worlds and 25 stages, survive endless waves in Infinite Mode, and ride the Dungeon Train for brutal Challenges!
👀 The Nightosphere and the Crystal Dimension are coming soon...

📱💻 Play on PC, Mobile & Tablet. Squad up with up to 3 friends and save the Land of Ooo together!
🔥 Like, favorite and join the community for new codes, rare rewards and update news! Redeem codes at Jake's Code Corner in the Tree Fort.
